signals.name: Working-Capital-Invariant Innovation Realization
signals.expression: MUL(RANK(MA(RATIO(COALESCE(xrd, 0), sale), 3)), MIN(RANK(MA(WINSOR(RATIO(SUB(SUB(oancf, recch), invch), at), 1), 3)), RANK(MA(WINSOR(RATIO(ADD(SUB(sale, cogs), ADD(recch, invch)), sale), 1), 3))))

signals.name: Intangible Excess Depreciation Addback
signals.expression: MUL(RANK(RATIO(MAX(SUB(intan, gdwl), 0), at)), ZSCORE(WINSOR(RATIO(SUB(dpc, dp), at), 1)))

signals.name: Innovation Dual Operating-Asset Buildup
signals.expression: MUL(RANK(MA(RATIO(COALESCE(xrd, 0), sale), 3)), MIN(RANK(MA(NEG(WINSOR(RATIO(recch, at), 1)), 3)), RANK(MA(NEG(WINSOR(RATIO(invch, at), 1)), 3))))

signals.name: Intangible Equity Fragility with Accrual Support
signals.expression: MUL(RANK(RATIO(MAX(SUB(intan, gdwl), 0), ADD(MAX(SUB(intan, gdwl), 0), MAX(ceq, 0)))), ZSCORE(WINSOR(RATIO(SUB(ib, oancf), at), 1)))

signals.name: Equity-Constrained Amortization Deferral
signals.expression: MUL(RANK(RATIO(MAX(SUB(intan, gdwl), 0), ADD(MAX(SUB(intan, gdwl), 0), MAX(ceq, 0)))), RANK(NEG(WINSOR(DELTA(RATIO(dp, ADD(dp, MAX(SUB(intan, gdwl), 0))), 1), 1))))

signals.name: Innovation Accrual-Reconciliation Gap
signals.expression: MUL(RANK(MA(RATIO(COALESCE(xrd, 0), sale), 3)), RANK(WINSOR(ABS(SUB(RATIO(SUB(ib, oancf), LAG(at, 1)), RATIO(SUB(SUB(SUB(DELTA(act, 1), DELTA(che, 1)), SUB(SUB(DELTA(lct, 1), DELTA(dlc, 1)), DELTA(txp, 1))), dp), LAG(at, 1)))), 1)))

signals.name: Shadow-Intangible Equity Accrual Strain
signals.expression: MUL(RANK(RATIO(TS_SUM(COALESCE(xrd, 0), 3), ADD(TS_SUM(COALESCE(xrd, 0), 3), MAX(ceq, 0)))), ZSCORE(WINSOR(RATIO(ADD(SUB(ib, oancf), dp), at), 1)))

signals.name: Clean Working-Capital Margin
signals.expression: MUL(RANK(NEG(ABS(RATIO(SUB(SUB(DELTA(act, 1), DELTA(che, 1)), SUB(DELTA(lct, 1), DELTA(dlc, 1))), at)))), RANK(SUB(MA(RATIO(SUB(sale, cogs), sale), 5), VOL(RATIO(SUB(sale, cogs), sale), 5))))

signals.name: Demand-Accrual Volatility Alignment
signals.expression: RANK(NEG(MAX(RANK(VOL(RATIO(revt, at), 3)), RANK(SUB(VOL(RATIO(ADD(ABS(recch), ABS(invch)), at), 3), VOL(RATIO(revt, at), 3))))))

signals.name: Realized Retained Earnings

signals.name: Debt-Adjusted Cash Retention
signals.expression: MIN(RANK(TREND(RATIO(re, at), 5)), RANK(SUB(TREND(RATIO(che, at), 5), TREND(RATIO(ADD(dltt, dlc), at), 5))))

signals.name: Receivable-Neutral Earnings Durability
signals.expression: RANK(SUB(MA(RATIO(ADD(ni, recch), at), 3), VOL(RATIO(ADD(ni, recch), at), 3)))

signals.name: Supplier-Neutral Book-Cash Agreement
signals.expression: MIN(RANK(SUB(MA(RATIO(SUB(oancf, apalch), at), 3), VOL(RATIO(SUB(oancf, apalch), at), 3))), RANK(NEG(ABS(SUB(MA(RATIO(ni, at), 3), MA(RATIO(SUB(oancf, apalch), at), 3))))))

signals.name: Working-Capital Profit Rescue Count
signals.expression: TS_SUM(MUL(INDICATOR(RATIO(ni, at), 0), INDICATOR(NEG(RATIO(SUB(ni, SUB(SUB(DELTA(act, 1), DELTA(che, 1)), SUB(DELTA(lct, 1), DELTA(dlc, 1)))), at)), 0)), 5)

signals.name: Margin Improvement Funding Test
signals.expression: MUL(IND_ZSCORE(NEG(RATIO(SUB(SUB(DELTA(act, 1), DELTA(che, 1)), SUB(DELTA(lct, 1), DELTA(dlc, 1))), sale))), INDICATOR(DELTA(RATIO(SUB(sale, cogs), sale), 1), 0))

signals.name: Receivable Reversal-Adjusted Earnings
signals.expression: RANK(WINSOR(SUB(SUB(MA(RATIO(ni, at), 3), VOL(RATIO(ni, at), 3)), MA(ABS(ADD(RATIO(recch, at), LAG(RATIO(recch, at), 1))), 3)), 1))

signals.name: Post-Margin Receivable Realization
signals.expression: MUL(IND_ZSCORE(NEG(ABS(ADD(RATIO(recch, at), LAG(RATIO(recch, at), 1))))), INDICATOR(LAG(DELTA(RATIO(SUB(sale, cogs), sale), 1), 1), 0))

signals.name: Hidden Trade-Credit Churn
signals.expression: MUL(IND_ZSCORE(NEG(MA(RATIO(SUB(ADD(ABS(recch), ABS(apalch)), ABS(ADD(recch, apalch))), sale), 3))), INDICATOR(NEG(ZSCORE(VOL(RATIO(SUB(sale, cogs), sale), 3))), 0))

signals.name: Smooth-Margin Nonworking Accrual Residual
signals.expression: MUL(IND_ZSCORE(NEG(MA(ABS(SUB(RATIO(SUB(ni, oancf), at), RATIO(DELTA(wcap, 1), at))), 3))), INDICATOR(NEG(ZSCORE(VOL(RATIO(SUB(sale, cogs), sale), 3))), 0))

signals.name: Verified Working-Capital Harvest
signals.expression: MUL(ZSCORE(MIN(RANK(LAG(RATIO(SUB(SUB(DELTA(act, 1), DELTA(che, 1)), SUB(DELTA(lct, 1), DELTA(dlc, 1))), sale), 1)), RANK(NEG(RATIO(SUB(SUB(DELTA(act, 1), DELTA(che, 1)), SUB(DELTA(lct, 1), DELTA(dlc, 1))), sale))))), INDICATOR(DELTA(RATIO(SUB(sale, cogs), sale), 1), 0))

signals.name: Self-Funded Trade Margin Gains
signals.expression: MUL(IND_ZSCORE(MIN(RANK(RATIO(recch, sale)), RANK(NEG(RATIO(apalch, sale))))), INDICATOR(DELTA(RATIO(SUB(sale, cogs), sale), 1), 0))

signals.name: Dual Margin Cash Confirmation
signals.expression: MIN(RANK(DELTA(RATIO(SUB(sale, cogs), sale), 1)), RANK(DELTA(RATIO(SUB(oancf, apalch), sale), 1)))

signals.name: Smooth-Earnings Supplier-Funded Inventory
signals.expression: MUL(ZSCORE(NEG(MIN(RANK(RATIO(NEG(invch), cogs)), RANK(RATIO(apalch, cogs))))), INDICATOR(NEG(ZSCORE(VOL(RATIO(ni, at), 3))), 0))

signals.name: Cash-Efficient Depreciation Congruence

signals.name: Depreciation-Stripped Nonworking Accrual Quality
signals.expression: MUL(IND_ZSCORE(NEG(MA(ABS(RATIO(SUB(ADD(SUB(ni, oancf), dpc), DELTA(wcap, 1)), at)), 3))), INDICATOR(DELTA(RATIO(SUB(sale, cogs), sale), 1), 0))

signals.name: Margin-Down Dual Accounting Stability
signals.expression: MUL(ZSCORE(SUMRANK(NEG(ABS(ACCEL(RATIO(wcap, sale)))), NEG(ABS(TREND(RATIO(dpc, sale), 3))))), INDICATOR(NEG(DELTA(RATIO(SUB(sale, cogs), sale), 1)), 0))

signals.name: Core-Cash Margin Co-Stability
signals.expression: RANK(NEG(MAX(RANK(VOL(RATIO(SUB(sale, cogs), sale), 3)), RANK(VOL(RATIO(ADD(oancf, DELTA(wcap, 1)), sale), 3)))))

signals.name: Asset-Release Margin Funding Quality
signals.expression: MUL(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(SUB(NEG(SUB(DELTA(act, 1), DELTA(che, 1))), SUB(DELTA(lct, 1), DELTA(dlc, 1))), sale)), INDICATOR(DELTA(RATIO(SUB(sale, cogs), sale), 1), 0))

signals.name: Margin-Decline Working-Capital Squeeze
signals.expression: MUL(IND_ZSCORE(NEG(MIN(RANK(RATIO(SUB(DELTA(act, 1), DELTA(che, 1)), sale)), RANK(RATIO(SUB(DELTA(lct, 1), DELTA(dlc, 1)), sale))))), INDICATOR(NEG(DELTA(RATIO(SUB(sale, cogs), sale), 1)), 0))

signals.name: Persistent Book-Over-Cash Margin Drift
signals.expression: RANK(WINSOR(MA(SUB(DELTA(RATIO(SUB(sale, cogs), sale), 1), DELTA(RATIO(ADD(oancf, DELTA(wcap, 1)), sale), 1)), 3), 1))

signals.name: Growth-Confirmed Asset-Release Funding
signals.expression: MUL(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(SUB(NEG(SUB(DELTA(act, 1), DELTA(che, 1))), SUB(DELTA(lct, 1), DELTA(dlc, 1))), sale)), MUL(INDICATOR(DELTA(RATIO(SUB(sale, cogs), sale), 1), 0), INDICATOR(GROWTH(sale, 1), 0)))

signals.name: Contraction-Confirmed Working-Capital Squeeze
signals.expression: MUL(IND_ZSCORE(NEG(MIN(RANK(RATIO(SUB(DELTA(act, 1), DELTA(che, 1)), sale)), RANK(RATIO(SUB(DELTA(lct, 1), DELTA(dlc, 1)), sale))))), MUL(INDICATOR(NEG(DELTA(RATIO(SUB(sale, cogs), sale), 1)), 0), INDICATOR(NEG(GROWTH(sale, 1)), 0)))

signals.name: Smooth-Earnings Cash-to-Accrual Substitution
signals.expression: MUL(ZSCORE(NEG(MIN(RANK(RATIO(SUB(DELTA(act, 1), DELTA(che, 1)), at)), RANK(NEG(RATIO(DELTA(che, 1), at)))))), INDICATOR(NEG(ZSCORE(VOL(RATIO(ni, at), 3))), 0))

signals.name: Durable-Margin Cash-Share Floor
signals.expression: MIN(RANK(SUB(MA(RATIO(SUB(sale, cogs), sale), 5), VOL(RATIO(SUB(sale, cogs), sale), 5))), TS_RANK(RATIO(che, act), 5))

signals.name: Liquidity-Strained Net Borrowing
signals.expression: MIN(RANK(RATIO(SUB(dltis, dltr), at)), RANK(RATIO(SUB(lct, act), at)))

signals.name: Cash-Conversion Equity Dependence

signals.name: Cash-Backed Distress Deleveraging
signals.expression: MIN(RANK(RATIO(SUB(dltr, dltis), at)), MIN(RANK(RATIO(oancf, at)), RANK(NEG(RATIO(re, at)))))

signals.name: Failed Maturity Refinance
signals.expression: MIN(RANK(RATIO(dltis, at)), MIN(RANK(DELTA(RATIO(dlc, at), 1)), RANK(RATIO(SUB(lct, act), at))))

signals.name: Debt-Demand Mismatch Spread
signals.expression: SUB(MIN(RANK(RATIO(SUB(dltis, dltr), at)), RANK(NEG(RATIO(DELTA(sale, 1), at)))), MIN(RANK(RATIO(SUB(dltr, dltis), at)), RANK(RATIO(DELTA(sale, 1), at))))

signals.expression: SUB(MIN(RANK(DELTA(RATIO(SUB(sstk, prstkc), at), 1)), RANK(DELTA(RATIO(SUB(ib, oancf), at), 1))), MIN(RANK(NEG(DELTA(RATIO(SUB(sstk, prstkc), at), 1))), RANK(NEG(DELTA(RATIO(SUB(ib, oancf), at), 1)))))

signals.name: Earnings-Confirmed Dividend Revision

signals.name: Depleting-Cash Payout Mix

signals.name: Unfunded Distress Dilution
signals.expression: MUL(RANK(SUB(GROWTH(csho, 1), RATIO(SUB(sstk, prstkc), at))), RANK(NEG(RATIO(re, at))))

signals.name: Failed Distress Equity Repair

signals.name: Emergency Debt Issuance Spike

signals.name: Liability-Reducing Noncash Dilution

signals.expression: MUL(RANK(NEG(DELTA(RATIO(che, at), 1))), SUB(RANK(RATIO(dltr, ADD(dltr, dltis))), RANK(RATIO(dltis, ADD(dltr, dltis)))))

signals.expression: MUL(RANK(RATIO(ADD(dvc, prstkc), ADD(dltr, ADD(dvc, prstkc)))), RANK(RATIO(SUB(lct, act), at)))

signals.name: Persistent Outflows Into Cash Decline
signals.expression: MUL(RANK(MA(RATIO(ADD(dltr, ADD(dvc, prstkc)), at), 3)), RANK(NEG(TREND(RATIO(oancf, at), 3))))

signals.name: Debt-Funded Payout Deficit
signals.expression: MUL(RANK(RATIO(dltis, at)), RANK(RATIO(SUB(ADD(dvc, prstkc), oancf), at)))

signals.name: Post-Loss Equity Debt Repair
signals.expression: MUL(RANK(RATIO(sstk, at)), MUL(RANK(NEG(DELTA(RATIO(ADD(dltt, dlc), at), 1))), RANK(NEG(LAG(RATIO(ni, at), 1)))))

signals.name: Operating-Cash-Covered Payout
signals.expression: MUL(RANK(RATIO(ADD(dvc, prstkc), at)), RANK(RATIO(SUB(oancf, ADD(dvc, prstkc)), ADD(ABS(oancf), ADD(dvc, prstkc)))))

signals.name: Creditor-First Covered Payout
signals.expression: MUL(RANK(RATIO(ADD(dvc, prstkc), at)), RANK(RATIO(SUB(SUB(oancf, dltr), ADD(dvc, prstkc)), ADD(ABS(SUB(oancf, dltr)), ADD(dvc, prstkc)))))

signals.name: Successful Term-Out of Prior Liquidity Stress
signals.expression: MUL(RANK(RATIO(dltis, at)), MUL(RANK(NEG(DELTA(RATIO(lct, at), 1))), RANK(LAG(RATIO(SUB(lct, act), at), 1))))

signals.name: Creditor Reprioritization During Cash Deterioration
signals.expression: MUL(RANK(DELTA(RATIO(dltr, ADD(dltr, ADD(dvc, prstkc))), 1)), RANK(NEG(DELTA(RATIO(oancf, at), 1))))

signals.name: Equity Resort After Debt-Access Retreat
signals.expression: MUL(RANK(RATIO(sstk, at)), MUL(RANK(NEG(DELTA(RATIO(dltis, at), 1))), RANK(DELTA(RATIO(lct, at), 1))))

signals.name: Creditor-First Covered Dividend
signals.expression: MUL(RANK(RATIO(dvc, at)), RANK(RATIO(SUB(SUB(oancf, dltr), dvc), ADD(ABS(SUB(oancf, dltr)), dvc))))

signals.name: Creditor-First Covered Repurchase
signals.expression: MUL(RANK(RATIO(prstkc, at)), RANK(RATIO(SUB(SUB(oancf, dltr), prstkc), ADD(ABS(SUB(oancf, dltr)), prstkc))))

signals.name: Debt Issuance Under Service Shortfall
signals.expression: MUL(RANK(RATIO(dltis, at)), RANK(RATIO(SUB(dltr, oancf), ADD(ABS(oancf), dltr))))

signals.name: Payout Into Deteriorating Debt Headroom
signals.expression: MUL(RANK(RATIO(ADD(dvc, prstkc), at)), RANK(NEG(DELTA(RATIO(SUB(oancf, dltr), ADD(ABS(oancf), dltr)), 1))))

signals.name: Failed Equity Risk Repair
signals.expression: MUL(RANK(RATIO(sstk, at)), MUL(RANK(DELTA(RATIO(ADD(dltt, dlc), at), 1)), RANK(VOL(RATIO(oancf, at), 3))))

signals.name: Intangible Risk-Capital Mismatch
signals.expression: MUL(WINSOR(SUB(RATIO(dltis, at), RATIO(sstk, at)), 1), WINSOR(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), sale), 1))

signals.expression: WINSOR(SUB(RATIO(ADD(SUB(sstk, prstkc), SUB(dltis, dltr)), at), RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), at)), 1)

signals.name: Issuance Commercialization Gap
signals.expression: MUL(RANK(WINSOR(RATIO(SUB(sstk, prstkc), at), 1)), WINSOR(SUB(DELTA(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), at), 1), DELTA(RATIO(sale, at), 1)), 1))

signals.name: Knowledge-Backed Net Repurchase
signals.expression: MUL(WINSOR(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at), 1), WINSOR(MA(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), sale), 3), 1))

signals.name: Research Duration Mismatch
signals.expression: MUL(WINSOR(SUB(RATIO(dlc, at), RATIO(dltt, at)), 1), WINSOR(MA(RATIO(COALESCE(xrd, 0), sale), 3), 1))

signals.name: Payout-Driven Research Retrenchment
signals.expression: MUL(WINSOR(RATIO(ADD(prstkc, dvc), at), 1), WINSOR(NEG(DELTA(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), at), 1)), 1))

signals.name: Intangible Financing Instability
signals.expression: MUL(WINSOR(VOL(RATIO(ADD(SUB(sstk, prstkc), SUB(dltis, dltr)), at), 3), 1), WINSOR(MA(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), sale), 3), 1))

signals.name: Intangible-Rent Deleveraging
signals.expression: MUL(WINSOR(RATIO(SUB(dltr, dltis), at), 1), RANK(WINSOR(RATIO(SUB(SUB(sale, cogs), ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0))), sale), 1)))

signals.name: Contractibility Capital Mismatch
signals.expression: MUL(WINSOR(SUB(RATIO(dltis, at), RATIO(sstk, at)), 1), SUB(RANK(WINSOR(RATIO(COALESCE(xrd, 0), sale), 1)), RANK(WINSOR(RATIO(SUB(COALESCE(intan, 0), COALESCE(gdwl, 0)), at), 1))))

signals.name: Lagged-Asset Rent Deleveraging
signals.expression: MUL(WINSOR(NEG(RATIO(DELTA(ADD(dltt, dlc), 1), LAG(at, 1))), 1), RANK(WINSOR(RATIO(SUB(SUB(sale, cogs), ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0))), sale), 1)))

signals.name: Lifecycle Financing-Drift Mismatch
signals.expression: MUL(WINSOR(TREND(SUB(RATIO(SUB(dltis, dltr), at), RATIO(SUB(sstk, prstkc), at)), 3), 1), WINSOR(TREND(RATIO(COALESCE(xrd, 0), sale), 3), 1))

signals.name: Joint Rent-Deleveraging Quality
signals.expression: MIN(RANK(WINSOR(NEG(RATIO(DELTA(ADD(dltt, dlc), 1), LAG(at, 1))), 1)), RANK(WINSOR(RATIO(SUB(SUB(sale, cogs), ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0))), sale), 1)))

signals.name: Identifiable-Intangible Term Match
signals.expression: MUL(WINSOR(SUB(RATIO(dltt, at), RATIO(dlc, at)), 1), WINSOR(RATIO(SUB(COALESCE(intan, 0), COALESCE(gdwl, 0)), at), 1))

signals.name: Intangible-Horizon Funding-Source Mismatch
signals.expression: MUL(WINSOR(SUB(RATIO(dltis, at), RATIO(sstk, at)), 1), WINSOR(SUB(RATIO(COALESCE(xrd, 0), sale), RATIO(COALESCE(xad, 0), sale)), 1))

signals.name: Advertising Duration Match
signals.expression: MUL(WINSOR(SUB(RATIO(dlc, at), RATIO(dltt, at)), 1), WINSOR(MA(RATIO(COALESCE(xad, 0), sale), 3), 1))

signals.name: Stable Identifiable-Intangible Term Match
signals.expression: MIN(RANK(WINSOR(SUB(RATIO(dltt, at), RATIO(dlc, at)), 1)), MIN(RANK(WINSOR(RATIO(SUB(COALESCE(intan, 0), COALESCE(gdwl, 0)), at), 1)), RANK(NEG(WINSOR(VOL(RATIO(SUB(COALESCE(intan, 0), COALESCE(gdwl, 0)), at), 3), 1)))))

signals.name: Deleveraging Reinvestment Test
signals.expression: MUL(RANK(WINSOR(NEG(RATIO(DELTA(ADD(dltt, dlc), 1), LAG(at, 1))), 1)), WINSOR(RATIO(DELTA(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), 1), LAG(at, 1)), 1))

signals.name: Equity Issuance Research Transience
signals.expression: MUL(WINSOR(RATIO(sstk, at), 1), WINSOR(ABS(SUB(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), sale), MA(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), sale), 3))), 1))

signals.name: Term Support for Research Expansion
signals.expression: MUL(WINSOR(SUB(RATIO(dltt, at), RATIO(dlc, at)), 1), WINSOR(MUL(RATIO(DELTA(COALESCE(xrd, 0), 1), LAG(at, 1)), INDICATOR(RATIO(DELTA(COALESCE(xrd, 0), 1), LAG(at, 1)), 0)), 1))

signals.name: Unabsorbed Research-Shock Financing
signals.expression: MIN(RANK(WINSOR(SUB(RATIO(ADD(SUB(sstk, prstkc), SUB(dltis, dltr)), at), RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), at)), 1)), RANK(WINSOR(MUL(SUB(RATIO(dltis, at), RATIO(sstk, at)), SUB(RATIO(COALESCE(xrd, 0), sale), MA(RATIO(COALESCE(xrd, 0), sale), 3))), 1)))

signals.name: Post-Raise Research Resilience

signals.name: Contractibility-Change Financing Match

signals.name: Debt-Share Research Uncertainty Support

signals.name: Reinvestment-Validated Equity Cushion

signals.name: Research Financing-Need Mismatch

signals.name: Uncertainty-Transition Financing Mismatch

signals.name: Equity-Cushion Dividend Rigidity Spread

signals.name: Rent-Scarce Research-Shock Mismatch
signals.expression: MUL(WINSOR(MUL(SUB(RATIO(dltis, at), RATIO(sstk, at)), SUB(RATIO(COALESCE(xrd, 0), sale), MA(RATIO(COALESCE(xrd, 0), sale), 3))), 1), RANK(NEG(WINSOR(RATIO(SUB(SUB(sale, cogs), ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0))), sale), 1))))

signals.name: Funding-Need and Deployment Mismatch

signals.name: Research-Scale Equity Cushion

signals.name: Intangible-Rent Risk-Capital Match
signals.expression: MUL(IND_ZSCORE(SUB(RATIO(dltis, at), RATIO(sstk, at))), IND_ZSCORE(VOL(RATIO(SUB(SUB(sale, cogs), ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0))), sale), 3)))

signals.name: Intangible-Rent Payout Adaptation

signals.name: Soft-Collateral Maturity Gap

signals.name: R&D Dual-Failure Fragility

signals.name: R&D-Adjusted Gross-Surplus Coverage

signals.name: Soft-Asset Creditor Duration Withdrawal

signals.name: Accrual-Investment-Covered Profit

signals.name: Balanced Operating-Accrual Margin

signals.name: Unpaid-Expense Profit Gap

signals.name: Customer-Funded Core Profitability

signals.name: Failed Excess-Accrual Investment

signals.name: Fully Burdened Pretax Profit

signals.name: Debt-Financed Accrual Profit

signals.name: Standardized Accrual-Investment Payoff

signals.name: Stable Accrual-Capital Margin

signals.name: Diversified Cash-Quality Margin

signals.name: Continuous Debt-Accrual Funding Pressure

signals.name: Accrual-Method-Consistent Profitability

signals.name: Net-Funding Profit Payoff
signals.expression: SUB(IND_ZSCORE(WINSOR(DELTA(RATIO(oibdp, at), 1), 1)), IND_ZSCORE(LAG(WINSOR(RATIO(DELTA(SUB(SUB(act, che), SUB(lct, dlc)), 1), LAG(at, 1)), 1), 1)))

signals.name: Accrual-to-Cash Realization Profit
signals.expression: MIN(IND_RANK(MA(RATIO(oibdp, at), 3)), IND_RANK(SUB(IND_ZSCORE(WINSOR(DELTA(RATIO(oancf, at), 1), 1)), IND_ZSCORE(LAG(WINSOR(RATIO(ADD(SUB(ib, oancf), dpc), at), 1), 1)))))

signals.name: Leverage-Weighted Profitability Inflection
signals.expression: MUL(SUB(IND_RANK(TREND(RATIO(SUB(SUB(revt, cogs), xsga), at), 3)), IND_RANK(NEG(TREND(RATIO(SUB(SUB(revt, cogs), xsga), at), 3)))), IND_RANK(RATIO(ADD(dltt, dlc), at)))

signals.name: Debt-Funded Cost Creep
signals.expression: MUL(IND_RANK(DELTA(RATIO(xsga, revt), 1)), IND_RANK(DELTA(RATIO(SUB(ADD(dltt, dlc), che), at), 1)))

signals.name: Leveraged Profit Drawdown

signals.name: Borrowed Cash Amid Operating Weakness

signals.name: Rollover Gross-to-Cash Disconnect

signals.name: Interest-Driven Cash Reserve Drawdown

signals.expression: MUL(INDICATOR(SUB(ADD(dvt, prstkc), oancf), 0), WINSOR(RATIO(MIN(ABS(ADD(sstk, dltis)), ABS(SUB(ADD(dvt, prstkc), oancf))), ADD(at, ADD(ABS(ADD(sstk, dltis)), ABS(SUB(ADD(dvt, prstkc), oancf))))), 1))

signals.name: Innovation Dilution-Adjusted Conversion

signals.name: Dual-Cushion Recovery Value
signals.expression: MUL(TS_RANK(RATIO(ebitda, MUL(prcc_f, csho)), 5), WINSOR(MIN(RATIO(DELTA(che, 1), at), RATIO(DELTA(re, 1), at)), 1))

signals.name: Loss-Confirmed Persistent Refinancing Trap
signals.expression: MIN(IND_ZSCORE(WINSOR(RATIO(TS_SUM(RATIO(SUB(dlc, che), lct), 5), RATIO(sale, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), 1)), IND_ZSCORE(NEG(RATIO(pi, at))))

signals.name: Compensated Pretax Loss Floor
signals.expression: IND_ZSCORE(WINSOR(RATIO(MAX(NEG(TS_MIN(RATIO(pi, at), 5)), SUB(RATIO(at, at), RATIO(at, at))), RATIO(at, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), 1))

signals.name: Residual-Cash Dividend Value
signals.expression: MIN(IND_ZSCORE(WINSOR(RATIO(dvc, MUL(prcc_f, csho)), 1)), IND_ZSCORE(WINSOR(RATIO(SUB(oancf, dvc), lct), 1)))

signals.name: Current-Claim After-Tax Operating Yield
signals.expression: IND_ZSCORE(WINSOR(RATIO(SUB(ebitda, MAX(txt, SUB(at, at))), ADD(MUL(prcc_f, csho), lct)), 1))

signals.name: Dual-Extreme Funding Trap
signals.expression: MIN(IND_ZSCORE(WINSOR(RATIO(TS_RANK(RATIO(lct, at), 5), RATIO(sale, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), 1)), IND_ZSCORE(NEG(TS_RANK(RATIO(oancf, at), 5))))

signals.name: Post-Payout Liquidity Residual
signals.expression: IND_ZSCORE(WINSOR(RATIO(SUB(SUB(oancf, dvc), MAX(SUB(lct, act), SUB(at, at))), MUL(prcc_f, csho)), 1))

signals.name: Cash-Realized After-Tax Operating Value
signals.expression: MIN(IND_ZSCORE(WINSOR(RATIO(SUB(ebitda, MAX(txt, SUB(at, at))), MUL(prcc_f, csho)), 1)), IND_ZSCORE(WINSOR(RATIO(oancf, lct), 1)))

signals.name: Cash-Supported Sales Expansion
signals.expression: MIN(IND_ZSCORE(WINSOR(RATIO(DELTA(sale, 1), MUL(prcc_f, csho)), 1)), IND_ZSCORE(WINSOR(RATIO(oancf, MAX(act, lct)), 1)))

signals.name: Cash-Backed Asset Productivity Recovery
signals.expression: MIN(IND_ZSCORE(WINSOR(RATIO(DELTA(RATIO(sale, at), 1), RATIO(MUL(prcc_f, csho), at)), 1)), IND_ZSCORE(WINSOR(RATIO(DELTA(che, 1), lt), 1)))

signals.name: Uncovered-Claim After-Tax Yield
signals.expression: IND_ZSCORE(WINSOR(RATIO(SUB(ebitda, MAX(txt, SUB(at, at))), ADD(MUL(prcc_f, csho), MAX(SUB(lct, act), SUB(at, at)))), 1))

signals.name: Current-Claim Payout Capacity Gap
signals.expression: IND_ZSCORE(WINSOR(MUL(RATIO(SUB(dvc, SUB(ebitda, MAX(txt, SUB(at, at)))), MUL(prcc_f, csho)), RANK(RATIO(lct, at))), 1))

signals.name: Creditor-Funded Productivity Erosion
signals.expression: MIN(IND_ZSCORE(WINSOR(NEG(RATIO(DELTA(RATIO(sale, at), 1), RATIO(MUL(prcc_f, csho), at))), 1)), IND_ZSCORE(WINSOR(RATIO(DELTA(lt, 1), at), 1)))

signals.name: Cash-Backed After-Tax Margin Recovery
signals.expression: MIN(IND_ZSCORE(WINSOR(RATIO(DELTA(RATIO(SUB(ebitda, MAX(txt, SUB(at, at))), sale), 1), RATIO(MUL(prcc_f, csho), sale)), 1)), IND_ZSCORE(WINSOR(RATIO(DELTA(che, 1), lt), 1)))

signals.name: Deteriorating Payout Capacity Trap
signals.expression: MIN(IND_ZSCORE(WINSOR(RATIO(SUB(dvc, MAX(SUB(ebitda, MAX(txt, SUB(at, at))), SUB(at, at))), MUL(prcc_f, csho)), 1)), IND_ZSCORE(WINSOR(NEG(DELTA(RATIO(SUB(ebitda, MAX(txt, SUB(at, at))), at), 1)), 1)))

signals.name: Funding-Gap Productivity Trap
signals.expression: MIN(IND_ZSCORE(WINSOR(NEG(RATIO(DELTA(RATIO(sale, at), 1), RATIO(MUL(prcc_f, csho), at))), 1)), IND_ZSCORE(WINSOR(RATIO(MAX(SUB(lct, act), SUB(at, at)), MUL(prcc_f, csho)), 1)))

signals.name: Liquidity-Floor Productivity Recovery
signals.expression: MIN(IND_ZSCORE(WINSOR(RATIO(DELTA(RATIO(sale, at), 1), RATIO(MUL(prcc_f, csho), at)), 1)), IND_ZSCORE(TS_MIN(RATIO(wcap, at), 5)))

signals.name: Dual-DuPont Valuation Trap
signals.expression: MIN(IND_ZSCORE(WINSOR(NEG(RATIO(DELTA(RATIO(SUB(ebitda, MAX(txt, SUB(at, at))), sale), 1), RATIO(MUL(prcc_f, csho), sale))), 1)), IND_ZSCORE(WINSOR(NEG(RATIO(DELTA(RATIO(sale, at), 1), RATIO(MUL(prcc_f, csho), at))), 1)))

signals.name: Weak-Link Value Confirmation
signals.expression: MIN(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(ceq, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at)))

signals.name: Balance-Sheet-Safe Retirement
signals.expression: MIN(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(ebitda, SUB(ADD(MUL(prcc_f, csho), ADD(dltt, dlc)), che))), IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(SUB(SUB(prstkc, sstk), DELTA(ADD(dltt, dlc), 1)), at)))

signals.name: Issuance-at-a-Premium Trap
signals.expression: MIN(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(MUL(prcc_f, csho), revt)), IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(SUB(sstk, prstkc), at)))

signals.name: Cash-Supported Financing Confirmation
signals.expression: ADD(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(oancf, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), IND_ZSCORE(ADD(SUB(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at), ABS(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at))), MUL(ADD(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at), ABS(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at))), INDICATOR(oancf, 0)))))

signals.name: Action-Specific Valuation Timing
signals.expression: WINSOR(SUB(MUL(RATIO(prstkc, at), INDICATOR(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(ceq, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), 0)), MUL(RATIO(sstk, at), INDICATOR(NEG(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(ceq, MUL(prcc_f, csho)))), 0))), 1)

signals.name: Countercyclical Financing Pivot
signals.expression: MUL(ADD(IND_ZSCORE(NEG(DELTA(RATIO(MUL(prcc_f, csho), sale), 1))), IND_ZSCORE(DELTA(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at), 1))), INDICATOR(MUL(IND_ZSCORE(NEG(DELTA(RATIO(MUL(prcc_f, csho), sale), 1))), IND_ZSCORE(DELTA(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at), 1))), 0))

signals.name: Security-Choice Valuation Alignment
signals.expression: MUL(ADD(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(ib, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(SUB(DELTA(ADD(dltt, dlc), 1), SUB(sstk, prstkc)), at))), INDICATOR(MUL(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(ib, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(SUB(DELTA(ADD(dltt, dlc), 1), SUB(sstk, prstkc)), at))), 0))

signals.name: Maturity-Screened Value Timing
signals.expression: MUL(ADD(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(ebitda, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at))), INDICATOR(NEG(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(dlc, at))), 0))

signals.name: Executed-Retirement Bottleneck
signals.expression: ADD(MUL(MIN(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(ceq, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), IND_ZSCORE(SUB(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at), GROWTH(csho, 1)))), INDICATOR(MIN(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(ceq, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), IND_ZSCORE(SUB(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at), GROWTH(csho, 1)))), 0)), MUL(MAX(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(ceq, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), IND_ZSCORE(SUB(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at), GROWTH(csho, 1)))), INDICATOR(NEG(MAX(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(ceq, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), IND_ZSCORE(SUB(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at), GROWTH(csho, 1))))), 0)))

signals.name: Cash-Normalized Equity Commitment
signals.expression: ADD(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(oancf, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), ADD(ABS(oancf), ABS(SUB(prstkc, sstk))))))

signals.name: Maturity-Weighted Financing Discretion
signals.expression: ADD(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(ebitda, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), MUL(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at)), IND_RANK(NEG(RATIO(dlc, at)))))

signals.name: Post-Deleveraging Repurchase Confirmation
signals.expression: ADD(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(ceq, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), MUL(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at)), INDICATOR(NEG(LAG(DELTA(ADD(dltt, dlc), 1), 1)), 0)))

signals.name: Fundamentally Validated Equity Action
signals.expression: ADD(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(ceq, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), IND_ZSCORE(ADD(MUL(ADD(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at), ABS(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at))), INDICATOR(GROWTH(sale, 1), 0)), MUL(SUB(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at), ABS(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at))), INDICATOR(NEG(GROWTH(sale, 1)), 0)))))

signals.name: Flexible-Payout Value Timing
signals.expression: ADD(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(sale, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), MUL(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at)), INDICATOR(NEG(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(dvt, at))), 0)))

signals.name: Two-Period Financing Concordance
signals.expression: MUL(ADD(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(sale, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), IND_ZSCORE(ADD(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at), LAG(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at), 1)))), INDICATOR(MUL(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(sale, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), IND_ZSCORE(ADD(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at), LAG(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at), 1)))), 0))

signals.name: Flow-Verified Share Retirement
signals.expression: SUMRANK(RATIO(ebitda, SUB(ADD(MUL(prcc_f, csho), ADD(dltt, dlc)), che)), MUL(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at), INDICATOR(MUL(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at), NEG(GROWTH(csho, 1))), 0)))

signals.name: Debt-Increase-Only Repurchase Quality
signals.expression: ADD(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(ebitda, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), IND_ZSCORE(SUB(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at), MAX(RATIO(DELTA(ADD(dltt, dlc), 1), at), SUB(ABS(RATIO(DELTA(ADD(dltt, dlc), 1), at)), ABS(RATIO(DELTA(ADD(dltt, dlc), 1), at)))))))

signals.name: Soft Two-Sided Financing Timing
signals.expression: ADD(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(sale, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), IND_ZSCORE(ADD(MUL(MAX(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at), SUB(ABS(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at)), ABS(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at)))), IND_RANK(RATIO(sale, MUL(prcc_f, csho)))), MUL(MIN(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at), SUB(ABS(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at)), ABS(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at)))), IND_RANK(NEG(RATIO(sale, MUL(prcc_f, csho))))))))

signals.name: Asymmetric Deleveraging Confirmation
signals.expression: ADD(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(ceq, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), IND_ZSCORE(ADD(MIN(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at), SUB(ABS(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at)), ABS(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at)))), MUL(MAX(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at), SUB(ABS(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at)), ABS(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at)))), INDICATOR(NEG(LAG(DELTA(ADD(dltt, dlc), 1), 1)), 0)))))

signals.name: Residual-Liquidity Buyback Feasibility
signals.expression: ADD(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(ebitda, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), IND_ZSCORE(SUB(MUL(RATIO(prstkc, at), INDICATOR(SUB(SUB(che, dlc), prstkc), 0)), RATIO(sstk, at))))

signals.name: Positive-Earnings Financing Concordance
signals.expression: MUL(ADD(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(ceq, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at))), INDICATOR(ib, 0))

signals.name: Payout-Mix Financing Conviction
signals.expression: ADD(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(sale, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), ADD(ABS(SUB(prstkc, sstk)), ADD(ABS(dvt), ABS(ib))))))

signals.name: Liquidity-Shortfall Adjusted Value
signals.expression: ADD(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(ebitda, ADD(MUL(prcc_f, csho), MAX(SUB(dlc, che), SUB(ABS(SUB(dlc, che)), ABS(SUB(dlc, che))))))), IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at)))

signals.name: Deleveraging-Intensity Financing Confirmation
signals.expression: ADD(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(ceq, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), MUL(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at)), IND_RANK(NEG(LAG(RATIO(DELTA(ADD(dltt, dlc), 1), at), 1)))))

signals.expression: ADD(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(sale, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), IND_ZSCORE(SUB(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at), MUL(MAX(NEG(RATIO(DELTA(che, 1), at)), SUB(ABS(NEG(RATIO(DELTA(che, 1), at))), ABS(NEG(RATIO(DELTA(che, 1), at))))), INDICATOR(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at), 0)))))

signals.name: Non-Deleveraging Issuance Penalty
signals.expression: ADD(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(ebitda, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), IND_ZSCORE(SUB(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at), MUL(MIN(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at), SUB(ABS(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at)), ABS(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at)))), INDICATOR(NEG(DELTA(ADD(dltt, dlc), 1)), 0)))))

signals.name: Residual-Earnings Buyback Coverage
signals.expression: ADD(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(ceq, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), IND_ZSCORE(SUB(MUL(RATIO(prstkc, at), INDICATOR(SUB(SUB(ib, dvt), prstkc), 0)), RATIO(sstk, at))))

signals.name: Per-Share Accretive Financing
signals.expression: ADD(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(ceq, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), IND_ZSCORE(SUB(MUL(RATIO(prstkc, at), INDICATOR(GROWTH(RATIO(ceq, csho), 1), 0)), MUL(RATIO(sstk, at), INDICATOR(NEG(GROWTH(RATIO(ceq, csho), 1)), 0)))))

signals.name: Repurchase-Specific Debt Funding Penalty
signals.expression: ADD(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(ebitda, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), IND_ZSCORE(SUB(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at), MUL(MAX(RATIO(DELTA(ADD(dltt, dlc), 1), at), SUB(ABS(RATIO(DELTA(ADD(dltt, dlc), 1), at)), ABS(RATIO(DELTA(ADD(dltt, dlc), 1), at)))), INDICATOR(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at), 0)))))

signals.name: Debt-Use Issuance Attenuation
signals.expression: ADD(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(ebitda, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), IND_ZSCORE(ADD(MAX(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at), SUB(ABS(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at)), ABS(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at)))), MUL(MIN(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at), SUB(ABS(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at)), ABS(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at)))), IND_RANK(RATIO(DELTA(ADD(dltt, dlc), 1), at))))))

signals.name: Operating-Covered Buyback Value
signals.expression: ADD(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(sale, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), IND_ZSCORE(SUB(MUL(RATIO(prstkc, at), INDICATOR(SUB(ebitda, ADD(dlc, dvt)), 0)), RATIO(sstk, at))))

signals.name: Excess-Cash-Burn Buyback Penalty
signals.expression: ADD(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(sale, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), IND_ZSCORE(SUB(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at), MUL(RATIO(MAX(SUB(NEG(DELTA(che, 1)), prstkc), SUB(ABS(SUB(NEG(DELTA(che, 1)), prstkc)), ABS(SUB(NEG(DELTA(che, 1)), prstkc)))), at), INDICATOR(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at), 0)))))

signals.name: Gradual Residual-Earnings Support
signals.expression: ADD(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(ceq, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), IND_ZSCORE(SUB(MUL(RATIO(prstkc, at), MUL(IND_RANK(MAX(RATIO(SUB(ib, dvt), at), SUB(ABS(RATIO(SUB(ib, dvt), at)), ABS(RATIO(SUB(ib, dvt), at))))), INDICATOR(RATIO(SUB(ib, dvt), at), 0))), RATIO(sstk, at))))

signals.name: Maturity-Priority Buyback Confirmation
signals.expression: ADD(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(ebitda, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), IND_ZSCORE(SUB(MUL(RATIO(prstkc, at), INDICATOR(NEG(DELTA(RATIO(dlc, at), 1)), 0)), RATIO(sstk, at))))

signals.name: Maturity-Weighted Clean Repurchase
signals.expression: ADD(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(ebitda, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), MUL(IND_ZSCORE(SUB(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at), MIN(MAX(RATIO(DELTA(ADD(dltt, dlc), 1), at), SUB(ABS(RATIO(DELTA(ADD(dltt, dlc), 1), at)), ABS(RATIO(DELTA(ADD(dltt, dlc), 1), at)))), RATIO(prstkc, at)))), IND_RANK(NEG(RATIO(dlc, at)))))

signals.name: Debt-Service-Covered Financing
signals.expression: ADD(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(ebitda, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), MUL(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at)), INDICATOR(SUB(ebitda, dlc), 0)))

signals.name: Liquidity-Capped Repurchase Credit
signals.expression: ADD(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(ebitda, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(SUB(MIN(prstkc, MAX(SUB(che, dlc), SUB(ABS(SUB(che, dlc)), ABS(SUB(che, dlc))))), sstk), at)))

signals.name: Continuous Fundamental Action Validation
signals.expression: ADD(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(ceq, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), IND_ZSCORE(ADD(MUL(MAX(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at), SUB(ABS(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at)), ABS(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at)))), IND_RANK(GROWTH(sale, 1))), MUL(MIN(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at), SUB(ABS(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at)), ABS(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at)))), IND_RANK(NEG(GROWTH(sale, 1)))))))

signals.name: Organic Book Accretion Value
signals.expression: ADD(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(ceq, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(SUB(DELTA(ceq, 1), SUB(sstk, prstkc)), at)))

signals.name: Revenue-Absorption Issuance Test
signals.expression: ADD(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(ceq, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), IND_ZSCORE(ADD(MAX(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at), SUB(ABS(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at)), ABS(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at)))), MUL(MIN(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at), SUB(ABS(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at)), ABS(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at)))), IND_RANK(NEG(GROWTH(sale, 1)))))))

signals.name: Cash-Adjusted Maturity Discretion
signals.expression: ADD(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(ebitda, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), MUL(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at)), IND_RANK(NEG(RATIO(MAX(SUB(dlc, che), SUB(ABS(SUB(dlc, che)), ABS(SUB(dlc, che)))), at)))))

signals.name: Solvency-Weighted Liquidity Repurchase
signals.expression: ADD(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(ebitda, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), MUL(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(SUB(MIN(prstkc, MAX(SUB(che, dlc), SUB(ABS(SUB(che, dlc)), ABS(SUB(che, dlc))))), sstk), at)), IND_RANK(NEG(RATIO(lt, at)))))

signals.name: Organic-Book-Supported Buyback
signals.expression: ADD(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(ceq, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), IND_ZSCORE(SUB(MUL(RATIO(prstkc, at), INDICATOR(SUB(DELTA(ceq, 1), SUB(sstk, prstkc)), 0)), RATIO(sstk, at))))

signals.name: Maturity-Migration Buyback Penalty
signals.expression: ADD(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(ebitda, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), IND_ZSCORE(SUB(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at), MUL(MAX(RATIO(SUB(DELTA(dlc, 1), DELTA(dltt, 1)), at), SUB(ABS(RATIO(SUB(DELTA(dlc, 1), DELTA(dltt, 1)), at)), ABS(RATIO(SUB(DELTA(dlc, 1), DELTA(dltt, 1)), at)))), INDICATOR(RATIO(SUB(prstkc, sstk), at), 0)))))

signals.name: Per-Share Revenue Outcome Confirmation
